products.title: Unscented Pure Soy Candle
products.description: An unscented candle designed for occasions where fragrance is not desired, such as while cooking or when diffusing oils. These handmade candles are poured in small batches using 100% pure American-made soy wax and clean-burning cotton wicks, providing a cozy ambiance without any added scent. They are vegan, cruelty-free, and phthalate-free.

products.title: It's Just A Cat Candle
products.description: A charming 11.5 oz soy wax candle designed for devoted cat owners. This candle features the humorous declaration, "It's just a cat." First of all, that's my child." It comes in the Exotic Cardamom fragrance, offering a unique aromatic experience. Made with 100% pure soy wax and premium fragrance oils, it features a lead-free cotton wick and provides a long burn time of 75-80 hours. The candle is housed in a white container and includes a natural wood lid, making it a perfect sentimental gift for any fur baby enthusiast.
key_features: First of all, that's my child.

products.title: Pet Odor Exterminator Deodorizing Candle
products.description: This 13-ounce scented candle from Pet Odor Exterminator is formulated with natural odor-neutralizing enzymes to effectively eliminate unwanted smells from pets, cooking, or smoke. The 'Rescued' scent profile is a refreshing blend featuring notes of orange, peach, wild raspberries, pink watermelon, lemonade, and sweet cantaloupe. Made in the USA, it provides up to 70 hours of burn time, perfect for long-lasting home fragrance. It is presented in a jar and is also suggested as an ideal gift for new pet owners.
